description: This Java class defines the entity 'PatientIdentifierType' used within the OpenMRS medical record system. It specifies metadata for patient identifiers, including formatting, validation, location behavior, and uniqueness constraints. The class includes enumerations for location and uniqueness behaviors, fields annotated for persistence, and accessor methods.

classes.name: PatientIdentifierType
classes.description: Represents a type of patient identifier used in the system, including properties such as format, validation, location behavior, and uniqueness behavior, with persistence annotations and associated enums.
